summary.text: José Sánchez-Sánchez, also known as Dante, is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 66 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the Democratic primary was canceled.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as electrical contractor and says he has served in the U.S. Air Force since 2016.

paragraphs.text: José Sánchez-Sánchez earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Florida in 2019, a bachelor's degree from the College of the Air Force in 2021 and a graduate degree from Columbia Southern University in 2024, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described his campaign as built on the values of God, family and community.
He listed fixing infrastructure such as drainage and roads, increasing teacher pay, expanding vocational training and lowering insurance costs among his key messages.
